title: fix(app-shell): the app bar's crumbs fold into one menu instead of cutting every segment (objectui#12702)
body:
Fixes #12702
Clause-②: no

## What changed

**Target 1 — the crumbs fold from the left.** The crumbs after the app pill (a `system/*` or report route's) are drawn by a module-internal `AppBarCrumbTrail` in `AppHeader.tsx`. Its layout is measured from the left group's own width: a `ResizeObserver` on the group and its children, comparing the children's natural widths. A natural width adds back what a truncated descendant hides, so a shrunk pill is not read as small. Each crumb's width is kept for its trail, so a folded trail knows what unfolding would cost and the layout does not flap. Where the crumbs do not fit, every crumb but the last goes into one menu. Its trigger is named by the existing `common.more` key (`aria-label` and `title`), built from the dropdown primitives the file already imports, and its items are the folded labels as plain text with no links. The last crumb keeps its full text. With room, every crumb is drawn in full, and the old 160 px cap per crumb is gone. A route with no crumbs (an object, dashboard or page route) renders as before.

**Target 2 — the PREVIEW chip moves after the crumbs when the row is narrow.** With room it stays beside the pill. Folded, it comes after the last crumb. Where even the folded row has no room for it, it is not drawn (see Deviations). It is still `PreviewBadge` in `AppHeader.tsx`; the app menu is untouched.

**Target 3 — the search keeps its width down to 960 px.** Every rule that keyed the centered search and its icon twin on `lg` now keys on one `min-[960px]:` variant: the trigger, the middle zone, the cluster's sizing and divider rules, the cluster's search group and the icon. The field and the icon never both show or both hide.

No new prop on `AppHeader`, no new i18n key, nothing new on the package entry. Below `sm` the phone bar is unchanged.

## Deviations

- **A third layout: folded, and the chip not drawn.** Measured at 1024 px on Setup › System › Marketplace, the left group is 388 px and the folded row with the chip needs 406 (trigger 32, mark 32, rule 19, pill 98, menu trigger 45, Marketplace 111, chip 69). Without this layout the pill still read 'Se…' and the crumb 'Marketpl…' at 1024 and 960 px. The chip is still drawn beside the pill at 1280 px and after the crumbs at 1100 px.
- `HomeLayout.searchOpensPalette-12601.test.tsx` (under `console/home/__tests__/`) pins the same shared middle-zone class, so its two lines moved to `min-[960px]:flex` with the rest.
- No route draws three crumbs today, so the three-segment case renders `AppBarCrumbTrail` in a left group of its own. The Marketplace route goes through the real `AppHeader`.

At 940 px the middle zone is gone, so the left group has room again and the crumbs unfold. The screenshots live on the evidence branch `claude/issue-12702-evidence` at `7c40ce3`, never merged into this branch.

## Test evidence (head `6204915`; this PR's head `d1f6eb7` is the same tree as one commit)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, full, once, foreground: exit 0, `Test Files 1478 passed | 1 skipped (1479)`, `Tests 13918 passed | 9 skipped (13927)`.
- New `AppHeader.crumbFold-12702.test.tsx` (10 cases). Three segments at a 320 px left group render pill, More and the last segment in full, and the menu lists the folded two. With room, every segment is in full and there is no More. The chip comes after the crumbs when folded and sits beside the pill with room. The fold follows resizes both ways. The search field and its icon switch at `min-[960px]:` only. CONTROL: an object route draws no crumb and no More.
- objectui#12472 pins moved from `lg:` to `min-[960px]:`: the side-zone sizing, the trigger's classes, the search group leaving at 960 px with its divider rules, the icon's class, the system-route control, and the studio-variant control.
- Each new or changed pin was ablated once with a literal anchor that must hit (11 mutations: never fold, chip placement ×2, no third layout, empty menu, unnamed trigger, field / icon / zone / cluster / icon group back on `lg`). All went red, and each restore ended with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `type-check` exit 0, `build` exit 0 (dist completeness 1130 files), `eslint` on touched files 0 errors with no new warnings, `check:i18n-keys` 0, `check:i18n-drift` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0, `check-changeset-presence` 0.

## Acceptance notes

- No route draws more than two crumbs on current main (a `system/*` route draws two, a report one).
- On the HotCRM dev backend in this container, the Marketplace page body reads 'Failed to load marketplace', most likely because there is no route to the catalog. The app bar is unaffected.
